kind: definitional clarification — NOT an amendment; no bet text in prereg_v9 is edited, added, or removed
note: prereg_v9 kill_thresholds.funnel_poisoning_V2 says a source funnel whose confirm shows 'error > 15%' is quarantined. The V2 confirm-pass (2026-07-23) surfaced that the outcome flips entirely on what counts as an error: counting citation-completeness misses (CITE) as errors quarantines 5 of 6 funnels; counting only wrong-value verdicts quarantines none. The term was undefined at seal time. This companion note fixes the definition; it does not change the threshold, the bets, or any decision rule.

definition.error_for_kill_criterion_1: FIX + OPEN only — a verdict that the drafted VALUE is wrong (FIX) or cannot be established at all (OPEN).
definition.excluded: CITE — the value is correct but the cited work does not establish it (wrong/one-sided/mis-attributed citation).
definition.rationale: The quarantine exists to stop a funnel that supplies WRONG FACTS. A right value with an incomplete citation is debt, not poison; it is mechanically repairable (add the hardness-side reference, split a merged citation) without re-deriving the fact.

companion_rule_freeze_gate.rule: NO cell enters the V3 freeze with an unresolved CITE.
companion_rule_freeze_gate.rationale: Check-9 is the atlas's identity. At freeze time a value whose citation does not establish it is indistinguishable from uncited folklore with extra steps. CITE debt therefore does not kill funnels, but it MUST be cleared before freeze.
companion_rule_freeze_gate.enforcement: V3 finalizer gate, alongside the existing 'no cells still `claimed`' gate.

applied_to_the_2026_07_23_confirm_pass.quarantine_outcome: NO funnel exceeds the 15% line; worst is dh at 14.3%. Broad scope stands, kill-criterion 1 intact and now precisely defined.
applied_to_the_2026_07_23_confirm_pass.cite_debt_outstanding: 47 cells — must be cleared before V3 per the companion rule above.

unchanged: Every bet (B1-B6), decision rule, population definition, and the other kill thresholds in prereg_v9 stand verbatim. The frozen atlas.jsonl (6d53a4f1...) and atlas_v2.jsonl (784f4739...) remain byte-identical. Locking rule still holds: a changed PREDICTION would require prereg_v10, never an edit; this note changes no prediction.
